children: NextNRG entered into an Amendment to its Securities Purchase Agreement with an institutional investor to update its $27.2 million Series C convertible preferred financing for a planned move to Nevada and a recent reverse stock split. The Amendment tightens conditions for additional mandatory closings, removes optional redemptions by holders, adds trigger events that increase stated value, and allows dividends in cash, stock, or by increasing stated value (subject to equity conditions). The company will file a revised Nevada Certificate of Designation and seek stockholder approval for all conversion shares.
